summary.prose: Building s5 adds one team gate in the workflow library and wires it into every place that changes a stage: the daemon's authoring and build steps, local approval and the approval of a target, finding application, and the automatic review fixes. It also adds the add-only addAssignee to the tracker port, a claim and a release operation, and two terminal commands (team claim, team release). A repo without a team policy is untouched; a team repo's changes are refused naming the holder.

tasks.title: Add addAssignee to the tracker port and the GitHub adapter
tasks.summary: Add the add-only addAssignee(issue, who) to TrackerPort in src/workflow/tracker/port.ts and implement it in the GitHub adapter (src/workflow/tracker/github-adapter.ts) beside setAssignee: it adds who without removing anyone, re-reads, and returns the assignees read back. setAssignee stays for release. This Task adds the method as the additive sc1 amendment AMD-315d510cb28100e2-12, which is still pending with s1 and needs its approval, as was done for findIssues; it changes no existing method. Other test doubles that cast to TrackerPort are unaffected.
acceptanceChecks: addAssignee adds the login without removing another assignee and returns the assignees read back
A failed or timed-out step is reported as a classified PortResult failure and is not retried
setAssignee behaviour is unchanged

tests.name: src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/github-adapter.test.ts: addAssignee adds without removing, returns the assignees read back and reports a failed step without a retry

tasks.title: Build the team gate core and the implicit claim
tasks.summary: Add src/workflow/team/gate.ts with GuardedAction, GateOutcome, ClaimState, TeamGateRefusedError and teamGate(repo, unit, action): allowed with no tracker call for no policy, teamMode false, claimsEnforced false or an unguarded action; otherwise load the tracker with the claim capability, make its own whoAmI call, read the assignee live, treat the assignee as the holder (logins compared case-insensitively), give held-by-other naming the holder, refuse several assignees and every port or policy failure, and take the implicit claim through addAssignee for author and build. Logs every non-allowed outcome with unit, action and reason. Never throws.
acceptanceChecks: A repo with no policy, teamMode false or claimsEnforced false is allowed with no tracker call
An unassigned stage is allowed for author and build with implicitClaim true and takes no claim for approve-local or applying a finding
A developer assigned directly in the tracker is the holder, with logins compared case-insensitively
Another holder gives held-by-other naming them whatever their idle time
Several assignees, every port failure kind and an unreadable policy map to refused with the reason and never throw

acceptanceChecks: The completion hook is consulted for the listed actions, a release from the hook does not consult it again, and with none registered the gate continues
A throwing hook refuses with its message and never throws

A missing issue that ensureUnitIssue can create is created and the gate then decides

tasks.title: Add claim, release and the review-fix decision
tasks.summary: In src/workflow/team/gate.ts add claim(repo, unit) (only an unassigned unit; addAssignee then a re-read; a contested or failed claim is refused and nobody is removed, and the wording says contention is reported when observed) and release(repo, unit) (clears the assignees through setAssignee for the holder or a policy administrator, including a contested claim; anyone else refused with no port write), and reviewFixDecision(repo, unit) returning apply-auto-fixes for the holder or when no gate applies and report-only for a non-holder or a failed read.
acceptanceChecks: claim takes only an unassigned stage and never removes another assignee
A contested claim and a failed re-read are refused; the interleaving where the earlier claimant returned allowed and only the later one observes contention is tested
release clears for the holder and for an administrator and refuses anyone else without calling setAssignee
reviewFixDecision returns report-only for a non-holder and for a failed read

tasks.title: Guard local approval and approval of a target
tasks.summary: In src/workflow/gates.ts make approveArtifactByJsonPath ask the gate for approve-local and throw TeamGateRefusedError before any review check or stamp, and make approveWorkflowTarget authorize each target before ensureBuildRecordOnCompletion creates or merges its BUILD record: a Story-wide BUILD is authorized against every Task claim of the Story (or against the Story unit when the Story has no Task units) and refused naming the first Task held by someone else, a standalone BUILD against the standalone unit, and an approval that cannot resolve a unit is refused. A TeamGateRefusedError puts the target in skipped[] with the refusal reason. Format the refusal in the terminal approve case in src/cli/command.ts beside the review-block message. Signatures are unchanged and a repo with no policy behaves as before.
acceptanceChecks: approveArtifactByJsonPath throws TeamGateRefusedError for a non-holder before any review check or stamp
A refused BUILD target creates no BUILD record, is in skipped[] with the reason, and the other targets are approved
A Story-wide BUILD is refused when any of the Story's Tasks is held by someone else and is authorized against the Story unit when it has no Tasks
The terminal approve command prints the refusal naming the holder
A repo with no policy approves exactly as before

tests.name: src/workflow/__tests__/gate-approve.test.ts: approveArtifactByJsonPath throws TeamGateRefusedError for a non-holder before any review check or stamp, and approveWorkflowTarget authorizes a BUILD target before ensureBuildRecordOnCompletion so a refused target creates no BUILD record, puts it in skipped[] with the reason and approves the others

tasks.title: Guard finding application and the automatic review fixes
tasks.summary: Make resolveReviewFinding in src/workflow/review/resolve.ts ask the gate before it writes when the action is apply and throw TeamGateRefusedError for a non-holder, leaving accept, override and defer unguarded, and show the refusal in the terminal resolve command in src/cli/command.ts. Make both automatic review paths, src/daemon/steps/review-step/phases/verdicts.ts and src/workflow/review/run-artifact.ts, consult reviewFixDecision and apply no auto-fix when it says report-only, so a review never writes content for a non-holder and is never refused.
acceptanceChecks: resolveReviewFinding with apply by a non-holder is refused before the markdown or the artifact is written, while accept, override and defer still run
A review of a stage held by someone else runs, reports findings, applies no auto-fix and leaves the revision unchanged
The terminal resolve command prints the refusal naming the holder

tests.name: src/workflow/review/__tests__/gate-resolve-finding.test.ts: resolveReviewFinding with action apply by a non-holder throws TeamGateRefusedError before writing the markdown or the artifact, while accept, override and defer still run

src/daemon/steps/review-step/__tests__/gate-review-fix.test.ts: a review of a stage held by someone else runs and reports findings, applies no auto-fix through verdicts.ts or run-artifact.ts, and leaves the revision unchanged

tasks.title: Guard the authoring routes
tasks.summary: Call the gate with action author in the workflow-step phases (src/daemon/steps/workflow-step/phases) and in the daemon's server-side driver (runWorkflowServerSide and its runStart stream handler in src/daemon/workflow-rpc.ts) at its start and before it writes the draft, each deriving its UnitRef from the request it holds. A held-by-other outcome throws TeamGateRefusedError before any state changes; the first-author exception lets the one first draft through. Analyze and code review get no call.
acceptanceChecks: workflow-step start, plan, step and synthesize on a stage held by someone else are refused naming the holder before any state changes
runWorkflowServerSide and the workflow.run done path are refused for a non-holder before the draft is written
The first author turn of a stage with no issue is let through
A repo with no policy behaves as before

tasks.title: Guard build
tasks.summary: Call the gate with action build in the build-step implement and validate phases (src/daemon/steps/build-step/phases) before they act, deriving the Task or standalone unit from the request, and throw TeamGateRefusedError for a non-holder.

tasks.summary: Add claim and release subcommands to the terminal team command dispatcher (runTeam in src/cli/command.ts) taking the unit as an epic hash, an epic hash and story id, or an epic hash, story id and task id, call claim and release through the services layer, and print the outcome or the refusal naming the holder in the same format as the review-block message.
